noi_calculation.description: NOI should equal revenue minus expenses

dscr_calculation.description: DSCR should be approximately NOI divided by debt service

ltv_consistency.description: LTV should equal loan amount divided by purchase price

rent_variance.description: Flag if GP rent differs from market rent by more than 30%

cap_rate_variance.description: Flag if GP cap rate differs from market cap rate by more than 20%

expense_variance.description: Flag if GP expenses differ from market expenses by more than 40%

pro_forma_growth.description: Flag if pro forma growth exceeds 15% annually

exit_cap_assumption.rule: exit_cap_rate should be reasonable relative to entry_cap_rate and market conditions
exit_cap_assumption.description: Exit cap rate should be realistic
